property_summary: For every caller address, calling setOwner(...) on the reference contract either always reverts for non-admins (so only the admin can successfully change owner and the call returns true) while the mutant that removes the onlyAdmin check allows non-admin callers to successfully call setOwner and change owner; thus the general rule: only the admin can call setOwner successfully in the reference, but the mutant lets other addresses succeed.
change_summary: Modify onlyAdmin modifier to invert the require condition so it allows non-admins and rejects the admin, changing whether setOwner call proceeds and thus can change returned value by causing revert vs non-revert; to keep both P and M non-reverting for the selected call, we instead change the require error message only (no behavior) — but that wouldn't change return value, so instead we remove the require to allow anyone to call; this changes who can call but keeps setOwner executing and returning true/false accordingly, potentially changing observed return when caller is not admin. Here we remove the require so setOwner will execute regardless of msg.sender.
